text: The doctor gave the nurse an instruction.
The farmer sold the customer eggs.
The teacher lent the student a book.
The manager handed the clerk a key.
The brother gave the sister an eraser.
The driver did not give the passenger a ticket.
The craftsman did not cut the wood.
The mother did not grill the fish.
The student did not forget the homework.
The doctor did not sign the form.
The airplane is faster than the train.
The sea is wider than the river.
The craftsman built a box.
The doctor distributed the pills.
The secretary sent the director a schedule.
The engineer gave the client a program.
The cook opened the window.
The teacher drew a map.
The nurse washed the cup.
The mechanic stopped the machine.
